name: Inworld Voice Isolator (open 48 kHz speech denoising model)
summary: Open-weight voice isolation from Inworld: removes background chatter, music and noise from speech while keeping laughs, breaths and the speaker's character. Two 48 kHz models share one architecture: an offline model (64M params) for recordings and a realtime model (58M) that streams with 20 ms lookahead. Also outputs the removed background, useful for vocal/music separation and dataset cleanup.

access.notes: One Apache 2.0 license covers code and weights (patent grant included, no separate model terms). HF repo ungated; weights auto-download on first use.

procedure: Run voice-isolate input.wav output_clean.wav (offline model downloads from Hugging Face on first use)
For live audio use --mode streaming --lookahead 2 or the VoiceIsolator(mode='streaming') Python API
Optional: pip install "inworld-voice-isolation[fast]" for CUDA kernels; Apple-silicon MPS supported

stats.cadence: v1 released 2026-11-18; restoration planned for v2 (verified 2026-11-20)

verdict.why: Rare fully open (Apache 2.0, code + weights) 48 kHz full-band voice isolator with both offline and streaming models; directly useful for podcast/video cleanup, game dialogue and speech datasets. New (repo created 11-16), ungated weights, pip install.
